title: The Sky Shadow
text: A shadow sweeps over the party, vast as a cloud, and the birds go silent. The air smells of smoke. Something is circling high above, too high to see clearly, a long dark shape against the sun.

options.label: Take cover and wait, and pray it is not hungry.

outcomes.text: It passes. Hours lost, under the smell of smoke.

options.label: The sharpest eye watches where it lands, so you know where not to go.

outcomes.text: Its lair, and when it leaves it.

options.label: The Leader signals it, to learn what it wants.

outcomes.text: An old dragon, curious, who gives you a ride.
